# Kuailu AI CRM | Features & Modules

## AI-Powered Lead Generation

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Smart prospect discovery | Identify potential prospects and organize them for follow-up. |
| Personalized email campaigns | Use AI assistance to prepare more relevant outreach. |
| Lead synchronization | Bring supported lead sources into a unified CRM workflow. |

## AI-Assisted Customer Engagement

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Customer insights | Summarize relevant customer and interaction information. |
| Sales guidance | Provide contextual scripts and next-step suggestions. |
| Risk alerts | Surface follow-up and opportunity risks for attention. |

## Smart Data Capture

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Automatic extraction | Extract structured information from supported customer interactions and records. |
| Follow-up logging | Reduce manual entry by recording supported sales activities. |
| Opportunity updates | Update supported opportunity fields and stages through configured workflows. |

## Sales Management & Analytics

| Module | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Leads | Intake, assignment, deduplication, public pools and follow-up. |
| Customers | Accounts, contacts, ownership, collaboration and customer history. |
| Opportunities | Stages, pipeline, forecasts, products and win/loss management. |
| Orders | Contracts, orders, collections and invoicing coordination. |
| Analytics | Dashboards, reports, targets and sales-performance insights. |
| Configuration | Forms, rules, labels, permissions, filters and product data. |
